description: This file is a Python script that defines configuration parameters, constants, and a command-line argument parser for a tool that generates JSON C++ classes, stub code, and API documentation from JSON definition files and C++ header files. It includes class definitions, global variables, and a function to parse command-line arguments.

classes.name: RpcFormat
classes.description: An enumeration defining JSON-RPC data formats: compliant, uncompliant-extended, and uncompliant-collapsed.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: A function that parses command-line arguments to configure the code generation tool, setting global variables accordingly.
